productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Learn and play with all your favorite Neighborhood friends: Daniel Tiger, O the Owl, Katerina Kittycat, and Jodi Platypus! Hi, Neighbor! Get to know Daniel Tiger and some of his friends and neighbors in these audio adventures from the Neighborhood of Make-Believe! Featuring real character voices and music from the beloved PBS KIDS series “Daniel Tiger’s Neighborhood,” inspired by the classic, “Mister Rogers’ Neighborhood.” Each card includes a character profile, three heartwarming stories adapted from the TV series, and an engaging quiz to see how well you’ve gotten to know each friend! Included in this pack is: Daniel Tiger: Daniel is always ready to explore. Join this brave tiger as he visits school for the very first time, helps his family around the house, and goes on a nature walk with his Dad Tiger! Ugga mugga! O the Owl: O is a very curious owl who is always learning and ready to share all he knows with his friends! Tag along with O as he tells a story about a dinosaur, goes on an indoor Trolley adventure, and figures out what makes him special. Nifty Galifty! Katerina Kittycat: Katerina loves to use her imagination with her friends! Come along with this graceful kittycat for a tea party with her favorite stuffies, a mozie-baking party with Jodi Platypus, and a dance party with Daniel Tiger, meow meow! Jodi Platypus: Jodi can be shy at first, but she’s a very silly platypus once she warms up! Follow along with one of the newest friends in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe on her first day of school, for an indoor campout at her Dad’s house, and at the market with her Nana! Yippy skippy! Tracks included: All About Daniel Tiger Daniel is Big Enough to Help Dad Daniel Visits School Daniel is Special Daniel Tiger Quiz Credits
